newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes softer in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes softer in thin trading.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar ended softer at C$1.3407 (US$0.7459) from C$1.3391 (0.7468) in thin trading, dealers said. * The U.S. dollar strengthened against other currencies, but the Canadian currency failed to follow suit, prompting cross-trading of the Canada. * The unit was expected to continue trading within tight range until data late next week.
Trading was expected to be light again on Monday, with the currency sticking to its range until Canadian economic data were released toward the end of the week, dealers said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1231 marks from Thursday's close at 1.1181 marks, but slipped to 82.98 yen from Thursday's 83.06 yen.
